messages:
Marie (PM): Compliance just asked for an easier way to answer 'who changed quotas and when' across projects. They need a Console view + bulk export (for SOC) — current audit export seems incomplete. Any thoughts on scope?
Alex (Eng): We have change-stream events in the infra DB but the Console surfaces only high-level actions. We don't capture field-level diffs or 'old_value' in most places. We could extend the event shape to include before/after JSON and actor metadata.
Sam (Security): Important: audit data must be tamper-evident and immutable for compliance. If we add before/after, store write-once copies (S3 with object-versioning) and publish a manifest with a hash chain. Exports must be signed and timebound.
Jess (Observability): From telemetry POV we should tag events with route, request_id, user_agent, and rollout_id. That lets us join to traces. Also we need retention policies and a way to surface incomplete/migrated fields in the UI.
Alex (Eng): Implementation options: a) augment current change_events table (add before, after JSONB, actor, ip, session_id) + daily partitioning; b) append-only event log (Kafka) + consumer builds materialized views for Console queries. Prefers (b) for scale.
Marie (PM): Console UX ask: show a compact 'Change history' sidebar per resource with timestamp, actor, short diff summary, and a 'download history' button that creates a signed archive. Also a quick filter: show only changes to quota.* fields.
Alex (Eng): Agree. For export API proposal: GET /api/v1/audit/export?project_id=123&from=2025-11-01&to=2026-02-01&format=ndjson. Response: queued job -> S3 signed URL. Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST 
  'https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/audit/export' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"project_id":123,"from":"2025-11-01","to":"2026-02-01","format":"ndjson"}'
```
log-bot: export-job-7345 queued by alex.estimated_size=1.2GB status=queued
Sam (Security): For compliance we also want: actor identity resolution (SSO id, service account), source IP, MFA state (if available), and whether the change was made via Console, API, or automation. We should record linked PR/automation run id when possible.
Jess (Observability): Performance note: full-text diffing on large JSON blobs is expensive. Suggest we store a compact delta (changed keys + old/new primitives) and keep full snapshots only in cold storage for exports. Also create a materialized "latest_config" view to speed up queries that show the current state.
Alex (Eng): Agree. Implementation backlog: 1) append-only event topic + consumer to generate compact deltas (alex) 2) export worker that creates gzipped ndjson to S3 + signs (alex) 3) Console UI for history + filters + download (jess) 4) retention + immutable storage + hash manifest (sam) 5) compliance acceptance criteria & API contract (marie).
Marie (PM): Compliance acceptance criteria: must include actor, actor_email, actor_type (user/service), timestamp, field-level before/after or delta, request_id, source (console/api/automation), and signed export within 24h. Also ability to export CSV/NDJSON.
Sam (Security): I'll draft retention requirements: hot indexed events 90 days, cold immutable archive 7 years, automatic export snapshot at customer request. Will also propose signing choreography and KMS usage.
Jess (Observability): UX notes: show inline diff with highlights, a small 'revert' button that creates a rollback change request (not auto-apply). Show action provenance badge (console/api/bot) and link to associated trace if available. Add :eyes: reaction for the mockups.
Alex (Eng): One open question: do we index by changed key paths for quick filter (e.g., quota.cpu) or rely on search? Indexing improves UX but increases storage and write cost. My suggestion: index top-100 commonly filtered keys and provide a secondary search pipeline for ad-hoc keys.
Marie (PM): Sounds reasonable. Timebox prototype for demo to Compliance next Tuesday. Alex, can you ship a prototype export + tiny UI by then? Jess and Sam, can you help with telemetry and signing notes?
Alex (Eng): Yes — will spike this week, push a branch and a demo export job.
Jess (Observability): Will add telemetry fields and a Console stub.
Sam (Security): I'll drop a doc with signing and retention matrices.
Marie (PM): Thanks. Follow-ups: please add short PR/issue links here when started.
Alex (Eng): created issue #2894 'audit: append-only change events + export' — will link PR soon. :thumbsup:
Marie (PM): great, closing the loop.
